sentences.text: The only known specimen preserves a complete skeleton that is about 57 centimeters long.
Its tail feathers are characterized by a central shaft that dominates the feather structure.
The species name honors the Mongolian paleontologist Rinchen Barsbold.
Fossils of Norellraptor were recovered from the Jiufotang Formation in China.
The genus is represented by a single specimen that retains impressions of its plumage.
The individual appears to have been a post-juvenile at the time of death, indicating it had not yet reached full adult size.

It lived alongside a diverse assemblage that included the large theropod Sinotyrannus, the early mammal-like Liaoconodon, the herbivorous dinosaur Psittacosaurus, and a variety of birds and pterosaurs.
Norellraptor belongs to the microraptorine subfamily of dromaeosaurid dinosaurs.
It is the sole species of its genus, named Norellraptor barsboldi.
Within Microraptorini it is considered the sister taxon of Zhongjianosaurus.
The animal lived during the Early Cretaceous Barremian to Aptian stages in a temperate, forested environment of the Jiufotang Formation.
